definitions.gloss: female-role actor in kabuki, male actor playing female roles
definitions.explanation: A male actor who specializes in playing female roles in kabuki theater. Since women were banned from performing kabuki in 1629, all female roles have been played by male actors trained from childhood in feminine movement, speech, and mannerisms.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{女形|おんながた}だ。
examples.english: He is a famous onnagata actor.

examples.japanese: {女形|おんながた}の{美|うつく}しい{所作|しょさ}に{観客|かんきゃく}が{見|み}とれていた。
examples.english: The audience was captivated by the onnagata's beautiful movements.

examples.japanese: {歌舞伎|かぶき}の{女形|おんながた}は{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}から{女性|じょせい}の{仕草|しぐさ}や{声色|こわいろ}を{厳|きび}しく{訓練|くんれん}される。
examples.english: Kabuki onnagata are rigorously trained in feminine gestures and voice from childhood.

notes:
READING:
Also read as おやま, though おんながた is more standard. The kanji can also be written as {女方|おんながた}.

USAGE:
{女形|おんながた} is one of the major role types ({役柄|やくがら}) in kabuki. The counterpart is {立役|たちやく} (male-role actor). Famous {女形|おんながた} include members of the Bandō and Nakamura acting families.

The art of {女形|おんながた} is considered one of kabuki's defining features and is highly respected as a specialized skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女形|おんながた}の{役者|やくしゃ}: onnagata actor
- {女形|おんながた}を{演|えん}じる: to perform as an onnagata
- {人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}の{女形|おんながた}: onnagata designated as a Living National Treasure
